title: Subject pronouns with plural olla forms
summary: Omit me or te when olemme or olette makes the subject clear; keep he in independent sentences.
objectives: Omit me or te when olemme or olette makes the subject clear; keep he in independent sentences.
Apply the pattern using the supporting forms shown.

sections.title: The ending can identify the subject
paragraphs: Olemme identifies me and olette identifies te. Olemme täällä still means “We are here”.
Keeping these pronouns is grammatical. When a task requests omission, practise the shorter sentence.

sections.title: Keep a clear third-person subject
paragraphs: Ovat does not identify which people are meant. Keep he when no earlier context names the group.
This lesson uses independent beginner sentences with explicit third-person subjects.

steps: The ending in olette identifies te.
The subject may be omitted when the addressee is clear.
Ovat does not identify which people are meant.
Keep he when no earlier context identifies the group.

commonMistakes: Follow an explicit instruction to omit the optional pronoun.
Keep the third-person subject clear in an independent sentence.
